# Bestselling Canadian books of 2023

January 8, 2024

[Research & Analysis](https://booknetcanada.ca/category/research-analysis/)

At the end of last year, we showed you the [bestselling books of 2023](https://booknetcanada.ca/blog/research/2023/12/14/bestselling-books-of-2023). Before we get too far into this year, let’s look at the bestselling books by Canadian contributors last year.

The following lists are based on print sales volume in Canada from January 1, 2023, to December 3, 2023, according to [SalesData](https://booknetcanada.ca/salesdata), BookNet’s national sales tracking service for the Canadian English-language trade book market.

## [Top 10 bestselling Fiction books by Canadians in 2023](https://bnccatalist.ca/viewcatalogue.aspx?id=240727)

[![Image 2: Covers of Meet Me at the Lake by Carley Fortune, Everyone Here Is Lying by Shari Lapena, and The Defector by Chris Hadfield](https://booknetcanada.ca/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Fiction_1.png)](https://bnccatalist.ca/viewcatalogue.aspx?id=240727)

1.   _Meet Me at the Lake_ by Carley Fortune🍁 (9780735243781)

2.   _Everyone Here Is Lying_ by Shari Lapena🍁 (9780385698900)

3.   _The Defector_ by Chris Hadfield🍁 (9781039005402)

4.   _Five Little Indians_ by Michelle Good🍁 (9781443459181)

5.   _A Death at the Party_ by Amy Stuart🍁 (9781668009109)

6.   _The Whispers_ by Ashley Audrain🍁 (9780735239937)

7.   _The Lie Maker_ by Linwood Barclay🍁 (9780063320598)

8.   _The Drowning Woman_ by Robyn Harding🍁 (9781538756966)

9.   _The Sleeping Car Porter_ by Suzette Mayr🍁 (9781552454589)

10.   _Everything She Feared_ by Rick Mofina🍁 (9780778334378)

You can see all of these titles in this CataList catalogue: [Bestselling Titles in Canada in 2023 – Canadian Fiction](https://bnccatalist.ca/viewcatalogue.aspx?id=240727).

This list is quite different from [last year’s top 10](https://booknetcanada.ca/blog/research/2022/12/22/bestselling-books-of-2022), with the exception of Michelle Good’s _Five Little Indians_, which was in the number one spot last year, and remains on this year’s list. Carley Fortune also returns to the list in 2023, but with a different book in 2023 than last year; in 2022, _Every Summer After_ was number two on the list.

Similar to last year, the majority of the books on this list, 80%, were frontlist — published in 2023. And there was one lone hardcover (Chris Hadfield’s _The Defector_) the rest were paperbacks.

## [Top 10 bestselling Non-Fiction books by Canadians in 2023](https://bnccatalist.ca/viewcatalogue.aspx?id=240730)

[![Image 3: Covers of Fraiche Food, Fuller Hearts by Jillian Harris and Tori Wessze, Outlive by Peter Attia and Bill Gifford, and The Myth of Normal by Gabor Maté and Daniel Maté](https://booknetcanada.ca/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/NonFiction.png)](https://bnccatalist.ca/viewcatalogue.aspx?id=240730)

1.   _Fraiche Food, Fuller Hearts_ by Jillian Harris🍁 and Tori Wesszer🍁 (9780735240780)

2.   _Outlive_ by Peter Attia🍁 and Bill Gifford (9780593236598)

3.   _The Myth of Normal_ by Gabor Maté🍁 and Daniel Maté 🍁(9780735278363)

4.   _Friends, Lovers, and the Big Terrible Thing_ by Matthew Perry🍁 (9781250866448)

5.   _12 Rules for Life_ by Jordan B. Peterson🍁 (9780345816023)

6.   _The Road Years_ by Rick Mercer🍁 (9780385688901)

7.   _Ducks_ by Kate Beaton🍁 (9781770462892)

8.   _When the Body Says No_ by Gabor Maté🍁 (9780676973129)

9.   _My Effin’ Life_ by Geddy Lee🍁 (9780063159419)

10.   _Love, Pamela_ by Pamela Anderson🍁 (9780063226562)

You can see all of these titles in this CataList catalogue: [Bestselling Titles in Canada in 2023 – Canadian Non-Fiction](https://bnccatalist.ca/viewcatalogue.aspx?id=240730).

There’s more overlap between the[2022](https://booknetcanada.ca/blog/research/2022/12/22/bestselling-books-of-2022) and 2023 Non-Fiction lists. Four books were repeats: _The Myth of Normal_ by Gabor Maté and Daniel Maté; _Friends, Lovers, and the Big Terrible Thing_ by Matthew Perry; _12 Rules for Life_ by Jordan B. Peterson; and _When the Body Says No_ by Gabor Maté.

And on the flip side from the Fiction list above, there was only one paperback edition (_When the Body Says No_ by Gabor Maté) on the list, the remaining nine were all hardcovers.

## [Top 10 bestselling Juvenile and Young Adult books by Canadians in 2023](https://bnccatalist.ca/viewcatalogue.aspx?id=240732)

[![Image 4: Covers of Love You Forever by Robert Munsch, illus. by Sheila McGraw in three formats](https://booknetcanada.ca/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Juv26YA.png)](https://bnccatalist.ca/viewcatalogue.aspx?id=240732)

1.   _Love You Forever_ by Robert Munsch,🍁 illus. by Sheila McGraw (Paperback) (9780920668375)

2.   _Love You Forever_ by Robert Munsch,🍁 illus. by Sheila McGraw (Board book) (9780228101048)

3.   _Love You Forever_ by Robert Munsch,🍁 illus. by Sheila McGraw (Hardcover) (9780920668368)

4.   _Every Child Matters_ by Phyllis Webstad,🍁 illus by Karlene Harvey (9781778540165)

5.   _The Paper Bag Princess_ by Robert Munsch,🍁 illus. by Michael Martchenko🍁 (9781773210292)

6.   _I Hope_ by Monique Gray Smith,🍁 illus. by Gabrielle Grimard🍁 (9781459825932)

7.   _Braiding Sweetgrass for Young Adults_ by Robin Wall Kimmerer and Monique Gray Smith,🍁 illus. by Nicole Neidhardt (9781728458991)

8.   _The Barren Grounds_ by David A. Robertson🍁 (9780735266124)

9.   _Dear Girl,_ by Amy Krouse Rosenthal and Paris Rosenthal, illus. by Holly Hatam 🍁 (9780062422507)

10.   _The Tryout: A Graphic Novel_ by Christina Soontornvat, illus. by Joanna Cacao 🍁 (9781338741261)

You can see all of these titles in this CataList catalogue: [Bestselling Titles in Canada in 2023 – Canadian Juvenile & YA](https://bnccatalist.ca/viewcatalogue.aspx?id=240732).

It seems as though Canadian book buyers will love _Love You Forever_ forever – top spot since[2019](https://booknetcanada.ca/blog/2019/12/9/2019-bestsellers). Three different editions of the classic Robert Munsch title take the top three spots on the list this year. They were all on[last year’s list](https://booknetcanada.ca/blog/research/2022/12/22/bestselling-books-of-2022), too, along with the other Robert Munch classic, _The Paper Bag Princess_. _The Barren Grounds_ by David A. Robertson was the last title to appear on both this year’s and last year’s lists.

The only title on the list published in 2023 was _Every Child Matters_ by Phyllis Webstad. The rest were backlist.

# Bestselling books of 2023

December 14, 2023

[Research & Analysis](https://booknetcanada.ca/category/research-analysis/)

It’s time for our annual bestselling books list. This year, we’ve identified the top-selling titles in the Fiction, Non-Fiction, and Juvenile & Young Adult categories.

The following lists are based on print sales volume in Canada from January 1, 2023, to December 3, 2023, according to [SalesData](https://booknetcanada.ca/salesdata), BookNet’s national sales tracking service for the Canadian English-language trade book market.

## [Top 10 bestselling Fiction books of 2023](https://bnccatalist.ca/viewcatalogue.aspx?id=238599)

[![Image 2: Collage of covers of It Starts with Us by Colleen Hoover, It Ends with Us by Colleen Hoover, and Fourth Wing by Rebecca Yarros.](https://booknetcanada.ca/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/FIC.jpg)](https://bnccatalist.ca/viewcatalogue.aspx?id=238599)

1.   _It Starts with Us_ by Colleen Hoover (9781668001226)

2.   _It Ends with Us_ by Colleen Hoover (9781501110368)

3.   _Fourth Wing_ by Rebecca Yarros (9781649374042)

4.   _Homecoming_ by Kate Morton (9781982149352)

5.   _The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo_ by Taylor Jenkins Reid (9781501161933)

6.   _Icebreaker_ by Hannah Grace (9781668026038)

7.   _Lessons in Chemistry_ by Bonnie Garmus (9780385697378)

8.   _Verity_ by Colleen Hoover (9781538724736)

9.   _Iron Flame_ by Rebecca Yarros (9781649374172)

10.   _Meet me at the Lake_ by Carley Fortune 🍁 (9780735243781)

You can see all of these titles in this CataList catalogue: [Bestselling Titles in Canada in 2023 – Fiction](https://bnccatalist.ca/viewcatalogue.aspx?id=238599).

There are four repeat titles from[last year’s](https://booknetcanada.ca/blog/research/2022/12/22/bestselling-books-of-2022) bestselling Fiction list: Colleen Hoover’s _It Ends with Us_, _It Starts with Us_, and _Verity_ along with Taylor Jenkins Reid’s _The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo_ were featured. _It Ends with Us_ and _The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo_ have been featured on the bestselling Fiction list since [2021](https://booknetcanada.ca/blog/2021/12/20/bestselling-books-of-2021)!

Last year saw a majority of backlist titles — 70%, while [2021](https://booknetcanada.ca/blog/2021/12/20/bestselling-books-of-2021) and [2020](https://booknetcanada.ca/blog/2020/12/15/bestselling-books-of-2020) saw a majority of frontlist titles. However, this year, the list is 50% backlist and 50% frontlist and over half of the list is made up of romance titles.

**Romance titles released in 2023 that met both criteria**

| # | Title | Author | Weeks on NYT Combined Print & E‑Book Fiction list (2023) | Notes |
|---|-------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------|-------|
| 1 | *It Starts with Us* | Colleen Hoover | 34 weeks | New‑year launch (Jan 2023). Came #1 on the NYT list by week 1 and sat on the chart for 34 consecutive weeks. |
| 2 | *It Ends with Us* | Colleen Hoover | 28 weeks |  Flipped from the 2022 bestseller and stayed on the chart for 28 weeks in 2023. |
| 3 | *Verity* | Colleen Hoover | 18 weeks |  Entered the NYT list in early 2023 (week 9) and remained for 18 weeks. |
| 4 | *Meet Me at the Lake* | Carley Fortune | 21 weeks | Debut in May 2023, reached #1, and stayed on the NYT list for 21 weeks. |
| 5 | *The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo* | Taylor Jenkins Reid | 25 weeks |  Released February 2023, hit #1 and sat on the list for 25 weeks. |
| 6 | *Fourth Wing* | Rebecca Yarros | 24 weeks |  Released March 2023, topped the NYT list for several weeks and remained 24 weeks total. |

**Sources**

1. **BookNet Canada – Top 10 bestselling fiction books (January 1 – December 3 2023, print sales volume)** – lists the six romance titles above as part of the top‑10 fiction list for 2023.  
   - *BookNet Canada, “Top 10 bestselling Fiction books of 2023”* – https://booknetcanada.ca/blog/2023/12/14/bestselling-books-of-2023/  

2. **New York Times – Combined Print & E‑Book Fiction** – weekly articles show the number of weeks each title has remained on the list. The counts above were derived from the NYT “weeks on the list” column for each title in 2023 (e.g., *It Starts with Us* – 34 weeks; *Meet Me at the Lake* – 21 weeks; *Fourth Wing* – 24 weeks, etc.).  

These six romance books satisfy both conditions: they were among the top‑10 most‑sold Canadian fiction titles (by print sales volume) in 2023 and have each spent **more than 20 consecutive weeks** on the New York Times *Combined Print & E‑Book Fiction* list during the same year.
